dropped.item: Framing of the lease-end timing as a 'natural exit' (the original presents the coincident June 2027 expirations as a natural opportunity, not just a penalty-free option)
The explicit 'Flexibility' label for rationale point 4, which named the benefit being argued

changed.item: 'Our performance is tied to anchor tenants and mall health rather than to our own brand pull' became 'more than to our own brand pull', which softens an either/or claim into a matter of degree
Denver staffing purpose: 'additional staffing to capture customers from the closing stores' (actively winning them) became 'additional staff to serve customers coming over' (assumes they will come)
Mitigations stated as definite plans ('Mitigation: ...') became conditional 'We'd ...' phrasing, which slightly softens the commitment
